name: @forguncy-react-workspace/cell-compiler
//devDependencies: Test-only, and pinned to versions measured in this repository rather than to
`react` / `react-dom` are the host versions #5 measured on Forguncy 12.0.100
(React 19.2.7). The host-bridge regression evaluates the generated JSX runtime
adapter against the same React the host injects, so the adapter's key/children
semantics are asserted against real React rather than a stub. Nothing in `src/`
may import React: mapping `react` to the host global is the entire point of #9.
`rolldown` is the bundler this toolchain actually installs (`vite-plus@0.3.2`).
#12's generated module is only correct with respect to the CommonJS-to-ESM interop
a bundler applies to it, and that interop is not visible in the module's own source:
the shapes that work and the shapes that fail silently differ only once a consumer's
namespace import enumerates the module. The regression builds through this bundler
rather than through a hand-written copy of its runtime helper, so an interop change
fails a test instead of breaking cells. Nothing in `src/` may import it.
